name: Hackers in the Loop
priceDates: 2026-09-11; network switch updated 2026-09-12; recent acquisitions researched 2026-09-18
costDefinition: Estimated equipment replacement/reference total using dated market prices, comparable-item allowances where a model or variant is unknown, and two owner-reported prices checked against current listings. Each line rounds quantity times unit cost plus the stated per-unit shipping to the nearest dollar. Tax and shipping are excluded except for the rack touchscreen. The original KVM line keeps a visible $1 rounding adjustment. This is not the amount spent or a donation valuation. Recent-acquisition power references are separate from the configured-lab power totals until installation and workload are confirmed.
powerDefinition: Planning estimates at the wall. Each group is counted once. Included components, uninstalled swap cards and spares do not add to totals. Working means mixed activity; heavy means the modeled systems are busy together.
exclusions: Room cooling, household router, UPS recharge after an outage, and fixed electricity charges are excluded. The 750 VA UPS overhead assumes an essential-load branch. Agent Blade power is projected for a populated board.
